summary: Pend Oreille County lookout with two 40-foot pole towers (1933 and 1936). The L-4 came down in 1955; footings remain at a lower site.

facts.design: Two 40-foot pole towers with L-4 and L-6 cabs
facts.status_note: The L-4 was removed in 1955; footings remain at the lower site, and the L-6 went back to the fairgrounds as a museum piece.

notes_for_editor: The 1955 L-4 removal is worded 'removed' by the register and Willhite and 'destroyed' by Firelookout; the story reports both. The end date of the north L-6 tower is not in any source read. Willhite's identification of the summit as the second tower's site is an inference ('likely'), and no evidence was found there. Access level is omitted because the sources do not say whether the public may pass the gate. Firelookout names a 1952 lookout; the name is not recorded here. WebSearch budget was exhausted before other sources could be checked.
